title: AndroidAPS doesn't take BG value in main window
symptom: AndroidAPS home screen shows a crossed-out BG value while xDrip+ tab and xDrip+ app show current BG readings. This happens after being away from the phone for some time; when new readings arrive, they appear in the xDrip+ tab but not in the main screen, and are not used in calculations until after another 5 minutes.
cause: AAPS did not receive any data from xDrip for a period (e.g., 15 minutes or 25 minutes) according to logs, and the phone was in a strange state during that time. The issue was not definitively resolved; it was closed for inactivity.
evidence_quote: anyway AAPS didn't receive any data from xdrip for 15 min
